scope_note: Single-feature zero-catalogue PILOT. It tests whether a potassium residual after thorium normalisation carries holdout-fault signal. It does NOT implement the silica (ASTER) normalisation in the parent hypothesis because the ASTER layer is not in the restored manifest.

official_sources.geodawn_page: https://www.usgs.gov/data/geodawn-airborne-magnetic-and-radiometric-surveys-northwestern-great-basin-nevada-and (radiometric data corrected for aircraft/cosmic background, radon background, Compton scattering and altitude)

input_layers.K: data/raw/external/geodawn_rad_u8.tif band 1 'K' (uint8, scale 1.0, offset 0; physical units NOT stated in the restored metadata; treated as ordinal)
input_layers.nodata: uint8 value 0 is treated as missing if the footprint-wide median of the band is > 0 (checked at run time and reported)

transform.step_1: Fit a robust linear regression K ~ a + b*Th over footprint cells with valid K and Th (Huber loss; no catalogue information).
transform.step_2_residual_arm: Residual R = K - (a + b*Th); standardise by footprint robust sigma (MAD x 1.4826).
transform.step_2_control_arm: Raw K, standardised by footprint robust sigma (no thorium normalisation).
transform.step_3: Gaussian smoothing sigma = 2 px (200 m) of the standardised field; score S = max(smoothed, 0), normalised by its 99th percentile over the scored footprint and clipped to [0,1].

placement: Identical to H80-DRAPE-PILOT: greedy descending-S placement, minimum 3 px separation, footprint & (distance to visible catalogue > 2 px), budget 37,654 binary dots.

arms.B_control_raw_K: Raw smoothed K (isolates the thorium normalisation)
arms.C0_random: Uniform random placement with the same spacing and budget (shared with H80-DRAPE-PILOT, same RNG seed)

primary_metric: HOLDOUT-DTI via vendor/gems57 evaluate (gems57-pooled-hide-v2), 4 quadrant folds pooled, paired physical 20 km block bootstrap, 1000 draws, seeds 20 and 30

decision_rules.R1_canary: Single-feature AUC of S for holdout truth vs background must be <= 0.90, else leakage is presumed and the pilot is stopped.
decision_rules.R2_th_effect: Arm A must exceed Arm B with paired 95% CI lower bound > 0 on BOTH seeds to attribute gain to thorium normalisation.
decision_rules.R3_spend_bar: A slot may only be considered if the best arm exceeds 0.1905 (seed 20) and 0.1944 (seed 30). Expected to fail for a single feature.

budget: Experiment 2 of 3 in this session; 2 seeds, 3 arms; no retuning of smoothing, band, or threshold after results.
named_non_fault_mimics: Potassic alteration of granitic and tuffaceous lithology with no fault control (lithology-driven K variation that thorium does not remove)
Playa and evaporite K-rich salts in closed basins (K enrichment without thorium)
Radon-related count variation in the uint8 channels
known_limitations: No ASTER silica or lithology layer restored; normalisation is by thorium only, so lithology control is partial.
uint8 quantisation of K and Th with unstated units limits the residual; ordinal treatment is an approximation.
A single feature with no learned model is not expected to beat the 0.1905 bar.
